notes.title: Major Game Update: New Features and Improvements!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a major update for our game, packed with new features and improvements that will make your experience even more amazing! Check out what’s coming:

1. Release for Linux and Mac
We know many of you have been waiting for this: our game will now be available on Linux and Mac! We’ve been working hard to ensure that the experience is smooth and optimized, no matter which operating system you use. Get ready to play on new platforms!

2. Controller Support
By popular demand, we’ve added full controller support! Now, you can enjoy our game with your favorite controller, whether it’s an Xbox, PlayStation, or another compatible model. Menu navigation and gameplay will be even more comfortable and immersive.

3. Game Optimization
We’re committed to offering the best performance possible. In this update, we’ve focused on optimizing the game to reduce loading times, improve frame rates, and ensure that system resources are used more efficiently. Less waiting and more time for fun!

4. Menu, Map, and Hangar Screen Overhaul
To make navigation easier and improve aesthetics, we’ve overhauled the menu, map, and hangar screens. These interfaces are now more intuitive, with a modern and functional design that will allow you to access everything you need quickly and easily.

5. Gameplay Improvements
We’re always listening to feedback from our community, and based on that, we’ve made several gameplay improvements. The experience is now more polished, with adjustments that make the game even more fun and challenging.

6. Enhanced Game Levels
The levels have been reviewed and improved to offer balanced and exciting challenges. We want each stage to be a unique experience that keeps you engaged and ready for the next adventure.

7. Achievement System Improvements
We know how important achievements are to the gaming community. In this update, we’ve made the achievement system more accessible and clear so that you can track and unlock your goals more easily and satisfyingly.
